pages.name: Inbox
pages.guidance: Show established messages and plausible incoming contacts consistent with relationships, schedules and privacy. Calls preserve each participant's physical location. Sending a message requires a player-authored choice.

pages.name: Time
pages.guidance: Display the established world date and time. Use the host calendar as authority. A turn counter is not an hour or date.

pages.name: Alarms
pages.guidance: List established alarms and appointments, or an empty list. Setting, editing or cancelling an alarm uses existing world rules after the player states their choice.

pages.name: Nearby
pages.guidance: Show the current location and known nearby destinations. Mark uncertain routes. Viewing leaves the player in place.

pages.name: Directions
pages.guidance: Ask which known destination the player wants, or show a route to their explicitly named destination. Travel requires a separate player decision.

apps.label: Food Delivery

pages.name: Orders
pages.guidance: Display only established orders and their recorded status, or an empty list.

apps.guidance: Show item prices, fees, substitutions, dietary information when relevant, destination and estimated arrival before explicit confirmation. Respect stock, access, weather and delivery conditions. Browsing is not ordering.
